solver.sde: dX=f(X)dt+B dW; f=(sigma(y-x), x(rho-z)-y, xy-beta z)
solver.fpe: partial_t p + div(f p - D grad p)=0; D=0.5 B B^T
solver.boundary: total reflecting/no-flux (f p-D grad p).n=0 on finite box
solver.fluxes: upwind advection; symmetric interior penalty diffusion

positivity.method: constrained L2 projection of cell averages, then Bernstein-coefficient scaling
positivity.guarantee: global mass preserved; all Q1 Bernstein coefficients on the limiter control subcells are nonnegative; hence the polynomial is nonnegative throughout each affine axis-aligned hexahedron
positivity.scope: postprocessed state at every completed timestep; not the unlimited algebraic solution

resource_estimates.note: Sparse matrix/preconditioner memory is implementation-dependent and additional.

stationarity.criterion: all subsequent cycle means within 0.5 final-window SD
